name: Tutorial
description: Interactive guided tutorial overlay with 15 steps covering Cockpit IDE features. Each step has title, description, optional target element (highlighted with ring), overflow hidden for canvas step, and lifecycle hooks (onEnter/onLeave). Navigation: ArrowRight/Enter for next, ArrowLeft for back, Escape to close. Renders step dots, Back/Next/Done buttons. Last step includes 'Do not show again' checkbox. External links on 'Stay Connected' step open in browser via shell.openExternal. Tooltip auto-positions (above/below/left/right) relative to target element.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Show overlay, start at step 0, register close callback

methods.name: getShowOnLaunch
methods.description: Return whether user wants tutorial shown on launch

methods.name: destroy
methods.description: Remove keydown listener and DOM elements

state.description: Saved to user preferences under showTutorial key
